runtime_safety_contract.planned_action_journal: An atomic durable action journal containing the exact approved action and idempotent recovery operation is written before any mutation command is attempted.
runtime_safety_contract.command_acceptance: Command acceptance records only the command return status; it is not physical fault effectiveness.
runtime_safety_contract.effectiveness: A bounded state-based loop separately proves attached-policy denial, healthy adjacencies, expected LSA withdrawal, and route withdrawal.
runtime_safety_contract.standalone_recovery: A new-process recovery/replay entry point reads recovery_intent.json and mutation_journal.json, validates the approved action identity, constructs only the approved inverse command, and records each recovery attempt atomically.
runtime_safety_contract.partial_mutation: Recovery is safe and idempotent for a journaled action that was planned, attempted, accepted, or effective when a process stops before normal restoration.

clean_checkout_contract.source_tests: Source-only tests use minimal valid Feature Vector v2 fixtures rather than ignored data/raw archives.
clean_checkout_contract.materialized_receipts: X3, X4 and X5 receipt tests use accepted_runtime plus require_materialized_receipts when their ignored archive is absent; explicit materialized verification remains mandatory whenever archives are present or requested.
